discovery_notes: Search-snippet leads only; 30 standard searches. First pass of Asia 2020-2026, covering 2020-2022. Search results came as summaries; claims limited to what they attribute to each URL. Reseller pages (usshoppingsos, fryguypins, k23japan, suruga-ya, carousell) and an eBay-derived summary not used. Release-year keys follow release date (e.g. SHDR 2021 dated pin released 31 Dec 2020 keyed 2020; TDR New Year 2022 pin released Dec 2021 keyed 2021). 2023-2026 untouched.
